title: Vroegtijdige pensionering personeel lager onderwijs 1976-1977
authors: Kamphuis, P.L., Cooymans, A., Rooy, A. de, Instituut voor gezondheidszorg * Tilburg (primary investigator)
contributors: Algemeen Burgerlijk Pensioenfonds, ABP * Den Haag (research initiator)
Instituut voor toegepaste sociologie, ITS * Nijmegen (data collector)
descriptions: Information on schools and teachers, identification of teachers on prolonged sick-leave in 1975 job history / sick-leave / school / colleagues / headmaster and school management / participation of parents / class / opinions on teaching methods and means / teaching as profession / changes in elementary education. Background variables: basic characteristics/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ education/ religion/ organizational membership
